_how: Hand labels of our Hero ability button, made by looking at x2 crops of the button area (frame px x 420..524, y 706..800) on contact sheets, every frame of each window, before the reader's output was compared. A = no button. C = grey button at its normal size (not affordable). R = light-blue button with the magenta badge at its normal size. T = anything else that shows a button: the white or blue flash as it appears, the gold-on-grey frames and the dissolve when the Musketeer dies. At this zoom a button that has started to fade or swell by a few grey levels still looks like R or C, so the first and last 1-4 frames of an R or C run are the eye's guess. 'absent_sample' are 70 frames per match drawn at random (seed 505) from outside the windows, each looked at.
